🚀 Lancement de la plateforme « L'Investi: 🚀 Launch of the "Environmental Investor" platform: a digital lever for young green entrepreneurship in Algeria
📍 Alger, 25 avril 2026 – Le ministère de: 📍 Algiers, April 25, 2026 – The Ministry of Environment and Quality of Life officially launched, Saturday in Algiers, "Environmental Investor", a national digital platform designed to support young project bearers in the green economy sector, with a particular focus on the circular economy and waste valorization.
🎯 Objectifs et fonctionnalités de la pla: 🎯 Objectives and features of the platform
🔹 Centraliser l'accès aux mécanismes de: 🔹 Centralize access to financing and support mechanisms for environmental projects;
🔹 Faciliter le dépôt et le suivi des dos: 🔹 Facilitate the submission and online tracking of applications;
🔹 Proposer des services d'orientation, d: 🔹 Offer guidance, technical support, and training services;
🔹 Simplifier l'obtention des licences de: 🔹 Simplify obtaining licenses for the collection and transport of recyclable waste.
Cette initiative s'inscrit dans une déma: This initiative is part of an administrative modernization approach, with the ambition of bringing public services closer to entrepreneurs, streamlining procedures, and strengthening transparency in the processing of applications.
🤝 Une dynamique interministérielle au se: 🤝 An interministerial dynamic in the service of sustainable development
Le lancement s'est tenu en présence des: The launch took place in the presence of the Ministers of Environment (Kaouter Krikou), Knowledge Economy and Startups (Noureddine Ouadah), and Youth (Mustapha Hidaoui), during an information day on "Youth and Environmental Investment".
👩‍🌾 Mme Krikou a souligné que la platefo: 👩‍🌾 Mrs. Krikou emphasized that the platform will help structure access to environmental activities, support youth entrepreneurship, and accelerate the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), while boosting the national economy through green investment.
💡 M. Ouadah a mis en avant le potentiel: 💡 Mr. Ouadah highlighted the economic potential of waste valorization: wealth creation, job generation, and reduction of the import bill.
🌱 M. Hidaoui a insisté sur l'importance: 🌱 Mr. Hidaoui insisted on the importance of developing a culture of initiative among young people by connecting them to existing support mechanisms. He announced the organization of a summer camp dedicated to green entrepreneurship, hosting nearly 250 young people for training and expertise-sharing sessions.
La journée a également permis de présent: The day also provided an opportunity to present:
📘 Le cadre juridique de l'économie circu: 📘 The legal framework of the circular economy, notably law n° 25-02;
💰 Les mécanismes de financement disponib: 💰 The financing mechanisms available via ANGEM (microcredit) and ANAE (self-entrepreneurship), to promote the integration of young people into the formal economy, particularly in recycling.
L'événement s'est conclu par la signatur: The event concluded with the signing of several partnership agreements between the concerned institutions, aimed at consolidating the support ecosystem for green entrepreneurship in Algeria.
« L'Investisseur Environnemental » repré: "Environmental Investor" represents a strategic step forward in transforming ecological challenges into economic opportunities, placing Algerian youth at the heart of the green transition through an integrated, transparent, and accessible digital support system.
